title: Demo Out Today For Our Golf Deckbuilding Roguelite!
author: The_Arcane_Open
selftext:
Hi all! Posting here again with an update that the the demo for our fantasy golf deckbuilding roguelike, The Arcane Open, is out today! In the full game you attempt to work your way through a three day tournament, building up your deck and equipment along the way. The demo, linked below, is the first day of this tournament:

**Demo**: click [here](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5277960/?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=organic) for the steam page, thanks!

**Build:** We have some coding & programming experience, but we're building the game on Godot and are using Claude to assist with all coding.

**UI/Design:** Several purchased tile assets as well as Tilewise for course design. Combination of PixelLabs and Grok for sprites and creation/ iteration of various UI Elements.

**Art:** Primarily using PixelLab for character creation and Grok to assist with the card art.

**Music/Sound:** Music is all created through Suno, can't say enough good things about their platform. Sounds are sourced through Freesounds, [bfxr.net](http://bfxr.net/), manual recording, and also created through Elevenlabs AI.

comments.author: No_Alarm7089
comments.body: Just out of curiosity, what made you go with Grok over other models for UI?
